query:
SELECT es.list_id AS "list_id!"
            FROM email_senders es
            JOIN documents d ON d.sender_id = es.id AND d.user_id = $1
            WHERE es.user_id = $1
              AND es.list_id IS NOT NULL
              AND lower(es.list_id) LIKE $2
            GROUP BY es.list_id
            ORDER BY count(d.id) DESC, lower(es.list_id)
            LIMIT $3
